title: [FancyZones] Unassigned Rotate windows across monitors shortcut hook gets stuck during drag operations

judgment.rationale: The open report provides a repeatable drag sequence, PowerToys 0.101.2362, a three-display setup, video, and a diagnostic ZIP. Source inspection confirms FancyZones tracks rotation key state on low-level key events and resets it on key-up/settings changes, but does not identify why a release is lost or why the overlay appears with no assigned shortcut; the hypothesis remains red.
evidence: PowerToys 0.101.2362 from Microsoft Store; Windows 11; three displays.
Steps enable monitor rotation with no shortcut, drag a folder/network path in File Explorer, release, then type.
Reporter says assigning a shortcut or disabling rotation prevents the symptom.
FancyZonesApp forwards low-level key events; FancyZones updates monitor-rotation KeyState on key-down/up and resets it when rotation settings change.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce with the rotation shortcut unassigned while tracing key-up delivery and rotation state across drag completion.

fix_assessment.rationale: A repository-side change is plausible, but the current causal hypothesis requires verification.

proposed_fixes.title: Prevent stale monitor-rotation key state after drag operations
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Red hypothesis: a key-up lost or reordered during drag leaves FancyZones rotation state active; no-hotkey configuration may also require a guard against activation. Neither mechanism is confirmed.

confidence.rationale: The state machine is scoped, but no evidence identifies the dropped event or the condition that starts the overlay.

verification: Repeat the reporter’s three-display Explorer/network-path drag sequence with no shortcut assigned.
After each drag, verify no overlay persists and ordinary keypresses reach the foreground app.
Repeat with a shortcut assigned and verify intentional rotation still works.
plan: Reproduce with rotation shortcut assigned and unassigned while tracing low-level key-down/up and KeyState across drag start/release.
Verify whether drag completion or no-hotkey configuration leaves a key recorded down/consumed.
If stale state is confirmed, reset only the affected state at the verified drag-completion boundary and guard preview activation when no valid hotkey exists.
Add focused coverage for key-state reset and unassigned-hotkey behavior.

issue_context.summary: FancyZones can leave keyboard handling and monitor-rotation overlays active after drag-and-drop when rotation is enabled without an assigned shortcut; the exact key-event transition remains unknown.
known_information: PowerToys 0.101.2362 from Microsoft Store; Windows 11; three displays.
Steps enable monitor rotation with no shortcut, drag a folder/network path in File Explorer, release, then type.
Reporter says assigning a shortcut or disabling rotation prevents the symptom.
FancyZonesApp forwards low-level key events; FancyZones updates monitor-rotation KeyState on key-down/up and resets it when rotation settings change.
inferences: A lost or reordered key-up during drag could leave rotation state inconsistent, but this is not confirmed.
The unassigned-shortcut condition suggests a missing valid-hotkey guard may be involved; source evidence does not yet confirm it.
issue_context.analysis: The detailed report supports maintainer-side reproduction without a generic information request. Source narrows the stateful path, but the correct fix depends on observing which key events arrive during drag.
initial_investigation: Inspected FancyZonesApp low-level hook forwarding and FancyZones monitor-rotation key-state updates/reset.
No confirmed cause or covering PR was found; a diagnostic bot’s window-handle correlation is not treated as causality.

reproduce.version_requirements: PowerToys 0.101.2362 or current supported build; Windows 11; three displays
prerequisites: Enable Rotate windows across monitors and leave its shortcut unassigned.
Use File Explorer and a repeatable drag target such as a network path.
steps: Perform a drag-and-drop operation and release it.
Type ordinary letters and observe monitor-number overlays or unintended system shortcuts.
Repeat after assigning a rotation shortcut, then with the feature disabled.
reproduce.expected_result: Drag operations do not leave the key hook or rotation overlay active; ordinary keys continue to reach the foreground app.
